top.headline: Citi Lifts Brent Outlook but Still Sees Oil Falling in 2027
top.summary: Citi has raised its third-quarter Brent crude forecast to $80 per barrel from $75 as the U.S.-Iran war drags on and repeated attempts at a deal fail to restore normal oil flows through the Strait of Hormuz.
